items.statement: GET on /redfish/v1/Systems/<str>/ResetActionInfo/ requires getActionInfo privilege and dispatches to handleSystemCollectionResetActionGet.
The GET handler validates the Redfish route and system name, initializes ActionInfo response metadata, then resolves the system index before requesting allowed host transitions.
Missing-property errors add fallback ResetTypes, while any other D-Bus error emits InternalError and returns before publishing Parameters.
AllowableValues always begins with ForceOff, PowerCycle, and Nmi, then gains fallback or translated transition values before becoming the ResetType parameter.
afterGetAllowedHostTransitions receives the transition vector, seeds three universal ResetTypes, and either extends fallback values or returns on a D-Bus error.
getAllowedHostTransitions reads AllowedHostTransitions from the indexed host-state service and object on xyz.openbmc_project.State.Host and binds the result callback to the shared response.
The asynchronous getProperty callback retains asyncResp through bind_front and later builds the ActionInfo Parameters response from the D-Bus result.
Tests require invalid_argument to produce HTTP 500, but bad_request_descriptor to produce the complete eight-value fallback ResetType list.
The ResetActionInfo resource exposes separate HEAD and GET routes, guarded by headActionInfo and getActionInfo privileges respectively.
items.description: The Redfish ResetActionInfo resource binds HEAD and GET to distinct handlers with their corresponding privileges.
